components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast sky-cyan action button for CSV export, formation detail inspection, and Tako.id creator CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #0369a1; border: 1px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.24); color: #f8fafc; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0284c7; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Support Me Spotlight Pill
components.description: Catchy yet palette-harmonious rounded pill CTA in the top navigation bar across both Dark and Light modes.
components.css: .ds-support-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.24) 0%, rgba(3, 105, 161, 0.34) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.54); color: #e0f2fe; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-support-pill:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.34) 0%, rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.44) 100%); }

components.name: Search & Autocomplete Input
components.description: Theme-aware search input with leading SVG icon and WCAG AA accessible placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; max-width: 340px; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 10px; color: #94a3b8; pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-input-bg, #080b11); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #2d3b54); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 10px 7px 32px; color: var(--color-text-primary, #f1f5f9); font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-placeholder, #8b9bb4); }

narrative.overview:
Portal Data Formasi CPNS 2024 is an independent high-density analytical workspace for applicants comparing 111,921 civil-service formations, real qualified applicant counts (jumlah_ms), and PP No. 5 Tahun 2024 net compensation scenarios across desktop and mobile screens. The interface defaults to a calm Nocturnal Obsidian-Slate palette for evening study and switches instantaneously without flash into a glare-controlled Daylight Slate-Alabaster ledger for bright daytime use.

Rather than burying search tools under hero banners, rainbow glows, or nested cards, the opening viewport immediately presents the national dataset strip, 12-column search workbench, and verified formation rows. Creator appreciation (Support Me header pill and the bottom QRIS + Tako.id spotlight) stands out through pill geometry, subtle sky-tinted spotlight washes, and crisp contrast that harmonize naturally with both Dark and Light modes without clashing colors or aggressive blinking effects.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-FOUC Dark and Light theme architecture maintaining WCAG AA (>= 5.0:1) contrast across every foreground, placeholder, and semantic badge in both modes.
Single sky-cyan interactive and creator-spotlight voice paired with three strictly semantic competition-status tones (loose/zero-applicant, moderate/indicative, tight/deduction).
Self-hosted Figtree UI typography paired with JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) reserved strictly for counts, ratios, currency, UUIDs, and SQL identifiers.
Single-layer containers divided by 1px hairlinesâ€”never cards nested inside cards.

rules.name: The One Interactive Voice Rule
rules.body: Non-destructive interactive controls, active toggles, and the Support Me spotlight stay within the Sky-Slate family (<= 10% chromatic area) so neither Dark nor Light mode suffers from clashing accent hues.

rules.name: The Semantic Data-Only Rule
rules.body: Emerald, Amber, and Rose encode quantitative meaning only: 0 Pelamar and loose ratios, moderate ratios and indicative Tukin notices, and tight competition or mandatory payroll deductions.

rules.name: The Data-Only Monospace Rule
rules.body: Reserve JetBrains Mono strictly for numbers, currency, formulas, UUIDs, and schema fields; keep academic program names (.major-tag) in Figtree.

rules.name: The 12px Functional Floor Rule
rules.body:
Functional UI labels, badges, and table headers never drop below 12px, and prose paragraphs (

) never drop below 14px.

rules.name: The Single-Layer Container Rule
rules.body: Never place bordered cards inside bordered cards; subdivide interiors using 1px hairlines (border-top, border-right, border-bottom).

dos: Do verify every new token and component in both data-theme="dark" and data-theme="light" at >= 4.5:1 contrast, keeping dark badges behind white-fill logos like tako_logo.svg.
Do right-align numeric columns (.col-num) with JetBrains Mono tabular-nums and non-breaking currency spaces.
Do keep Support Me visually inviting through pill shape and harmonious sky-tinted spotlight washes rather than clashing off-palette colors.
donts: Don't use emerald for buttons or figures unrelated to 0 Pelamar or Sangat Longgar competition states.
Don't use emoji glyphs, blinking notification dots, shimmer sweeps, gradient text, eyebrow kickers, or nested bordered cards.
